Diagnosis: the failure is a pre-Runtime discovery/availability mismatch on Windows, not a Runtime permission issue. In `windows-discovery`, discovery resolves candidates via `LookPath` and absolute-path checks, but then requires `filepath.IsAbs(...) && executableAvailable(...)` before a launcher is accepted. In `windows-availability`, `executableAvailable` is shown to require a regular file with Unix execute bits (`0o111`), which is correct for Unix but would reject Windows native launchers and shims such as `codex.cmd` before the Runtime probe. In `windows-console-preflight`, the Console marks an agent `ExecutableReady` only after `executableAvailable(executablePath)`, so the same pre-Runtime gate can suppress an otherwise valid Windows install. In `windows-enrollment`, CLI enrollment also preflights `codex` using path resolution plus the same availability gate, so the rejection can happen before any Runtime-based validation. Evidence: [`windows-discovery`](#), [`windows-availability`](#), [`windows-console-preflight`](#), [`windows-enrollment`](#).

Diagnosis: the pre-Runtime gate is enforcing a Unix-style “regular file + execute bit” rule in two places, and that is the likely Windows failure. In `windows-enrollment`, `codex` is resolved with `exec.LookPath`, then rejected unless `os.Stat` succeeds and `Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0`, so a valid Windows launcher or npm shim such as `codex.cmd` can be rejected before any Runtime probe. In `windows-console-preflight`, the console marks `ExecutableReady` solely from `executableAvailable(executablePath)`, so the same preflight can surface the agent as unavailable before runtime validation. Evidence: [windows-enrollment](/private/tmp/convene-wire-test-run-46zlH8/tmp/convenewire-qa074-live-MIrsue/invocation-4/workspace/bridge/cmd/agentroom-bridge/main.go), [windows-console-preflight](/private/tmp/convene-wire-test-run-46zlH8/tmp/convenewire-qa074-live-MIrsue/invocation-4/workspace/bridge/internal/console/server.go), [windows-availability](/private/tmp/convene-wire-test-run-46zlH8/tmp/convenewire-qa074-live-MIrsue/invocation-4/workspace/bridge/internal/console/server.go).
